name: math-race-flow
description: Math race end to end (goal-math-app-v1): a wrong answer adds 3s and keeps the same fact on screen until it is answered right; after 2 misses the answer is revealed; finishing records the session, the missed fact, a best time and per-fact stats that the Progress map shows.

steps.label: problem is an add/sub fact up to 10
stub navigator.vibrate to record haptic calls
right answer: my digits show GREEN on the solved problem, card glows, key flashes, haptic tick + ok pulse
the confirmation is free: the clock is frozen during the green hold
after the hold the next problem shows with an empty slot
wrong answer: +3s penalty, same fact kept, try-again hint + double buzz
second miss: the wrong digits flash red and the hint gives the answer
steps.js: (function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}var a=ans(),w=String(a).length===1?(a===9?8:a+1):a+1;type(w);var el=document.getElementById('answer');return el.classList.contains('bad')&&el.textContent===String(w)&&document.getElementById('hint').textContent==='It\'s '+a+'. Type it to keep going.';})()

steps.label: after the flash the answer shows ghosted (reveal after 2 misses)
the hold is really free: over 5 answers the race clock moves less than half the wall time (review #8)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}function rd(){return parseFloat(document.getElementById('clock').textContent);}var c0=rd(),t0=performance.now();for(var i=0;i<5;i++){type(ans());await sleep(330);}var dc=(rd()-c0)*1000,dt=performance.now()-t0;window.__holdRatio=dc/dt;return dc/dt<0.5;})()

steps.label: answer every remaining fact correctly (waiting out each green hold)
steps.js: (async function(){function ans(){var t=document.getElementById('problem').textContent.split(' ');var a=+t[0],b=+t[2],o=t[1];return o==='+'?a+b:(o==='\u2212'?a-b:(o==='\u00d7'?a*b:a/b));}function type(n){String(n).split('').forEach(function(d){document.querySelector('#keypad [data-k="'+d+'"]').click();});}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}var n=0;while(!document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n<40){type(ans());n++;await sleep(330);}return document.getElementById('runLayer').hidden&&n===4;})()

steps.label: results: time incl. 6s penalty, 1 missed, the missed fact listed
Start shows the new best time
fact map colours the facts just practised (the missed fact is weak on its own op map)
recent workouts lists the race with a BEST tag
